dates.notes: Date of ratification (DOR) 2026-07-12; date of availability (DAV) 2026-07-22; date of announcement (DOA) 2026-10-31; date of publication (DOP) and date of withdrawal (DOW) 2027-01-31. Cited in the Official Journal as OJ L, 2026/2274 (2026-10-14) for Directive 2024/1689. The implementation dates and work item JT021039 were recorded from CEN's project data, whose page is served only with a session checksum; the stable citations in this record are the CEN-CENELEC article and the OJEU decision.

gaps: A European standard, not a treaty or an international instrument: no signature, ratification or depositary.
Paywalled: the standard is sold through the national standards bodies; only the CEN-CENELEC metadata was read.
Other JTC 21 work items (for example prEN 18228 on AI risk management, prEN 18283 on bias and prEN 18285 on conformity assessment) are not catalogued individually.
National adoption and the presumption of conformity attached to the OJEU citation are not assessed.

languages.note: CEN publishes European standards in its three official language versions (English, French and German). The metadata page was read in English.

related.note: Developed under standardisation request M/593 as amended by M/613 to support Regulation (EU) 2024/1689; cited in OJ L 2026/2274.

ai_provisions: Quality management system for organisations that provide AI systems, primarily those placing on the market or putting into service high-risk AI systems; intended to support applicable regulatory requirements under the EU AI Act.
relevance.excluded_scope: Voluntary European standard; it supports legal conformity but is not itself law and creates no obligation.
relevance.reason: EN 18286:2026 is a published European standard developed by CEN/CLC/JTC 21 under the AI Act standardisation request. It is catalogued at metadata level as part of the standards layer; the committee itself is not an instrument.

rights.note: European standards are sold through the national standards bodies. This corpus stores metadata and links only and does not reproduce the standard.
